Bind SM100 ragged decode natively and preserve 64-bit token strides (#1367)

* Extend SM100 native decode binding to D64/D256 and standalone execution

* Bind SM100 split-KV decode and combine launches natively

* Keep standalone scratch outside prepared split binding

* Preserve declared split shape diagnostic precedence

* Bind SM100 ragged decode natively with 64-bit token divisors

* Preserve declared packing for square ragged Stats

* Declare packed Stats layout in combine ABI regression fixture

* Require caller workspace for standalone half split attention

+def _equal(s, facts, workspace=0x100000, stream=17):
+    expected = prep.bind_dense_split(s, facts, workspace, stream, stream)
+    actual = s.native.bind_split(_pack(facts), prep._NATIVE_DENSE_INDICES, workspace, stream)
+    assert (actual is None) == (expected is None)
+    if actual is not None:
+        assert list(actual[0]) == expected[0]
+        assert actual[1] == expected[1]
